title: Provider-neutral Git and publication evidence bridge

observations.head_rule: branch.head, commit.id, review.target_head, merge.target_head, and publication.target_head are identical
observations.signature_rule: commit.signature.status is valid and commit.dco.status is signed; both are observations, not cryptographic verification
observations.evidence_rule: Each component has exactly one unique evidence reference whose digest is the canonical SHA-256 digest of that component

privacy.allowed_values: bounded identifiers, enumerations, booleans, integer revision, and SHA-256 or Git object digests

failure_semantics.side_effects: The model and checker perform no network, provider, Git, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, UI, merge, or publication operation.

limitations: A valid envelope proves only that supplied observations are structurally and digest-consistent.
The checker does not inspect a repository, verify a signature, verify a DCO trailer, contact a review system, merge, publish, or establish remote or hosted-CI success.
Review status is an observation for AWQ and Coordinator policy; it is not a runtime approval or task transition.
follow_up: Coordinator remains authoritative for task revision, claims, leases, and durable state.
AWQ remains authoritative for requirements, gates, and acceptance of this evidence.
A future integration may consume this envelope only through approved Coordinator and AWQ contracts.
